import json,subprocess,sys,time
H=256
kinds='K'*253+'ZQT' # H256 D0, Q idx254,T255
f=dict(id='f',path=['n0','n1','n2','n3','n4','n5','n6','n7','r'],template='00'*H,kinds=kinds,labels=list(range(16,25)))
hb=bytearray(H);hb[-1]=255
ev=[{'op':'packet','flow':'f','header':bytes(hb).hex(),'payload':''} for _ in range(8192)]
req=dict(mode='replay',capacities={x:1 for x in f['path']},flows=[f],events=ev)
data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':'))+'\n'
print('inMB',len(data)/1024/1024)
st=time.time();p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
print('rc',p.returncode,'outMiB',len(p.stdout)/1024/1024,'time',time.time()-st,'err',p.stderr[:100])
o=json.loads(p.stdout);r=o['results'][0];print(len(o['results']),r['mode'],r['byte_hops'],len(r['wire']),len(r['delivered']))
